description: Attestation-gated SPL escrow for agent jobs on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32.1). create_job, fund, submit_evidence and release were verified: 1_000_000 lab tokens locked in the job escrow, evidence submitted, a release without an Ed25519 precompile rejected (MissingEd25519Instruction), and a lab verifier signature released the tokens so the escrow ATA ended at 0.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of JuanMarchetto/veedor. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/veedor. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and pointed the Anchor.toml program id at that key. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset covering create_job, fund, submit_evidence, release, resolve and crank_timeout; discriminators were confirmed by the verifying transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (create_job, fund, submit_evidence, release with Ed25519 attestation)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/veedor/
QA: devnet proof of the attested release path and MissingEd25519Instruction rejection
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Replace the hand-derived hosted IDL with an Anchor-generated one once idl-build can run in this lab (openssl/make currently block it)
